newsitem.title: ABU DHABI: Abu Dhabi Commercial Bank lifts net profits.
newsitem.headline: Abu Dhabi Commercial Bank lifts net profits.

text.p: Abu Dhabi Commercial Bank will distribute dividends totalling 62 million dirhams, equal to five percent of its capital, to shareholders for 1996, the official United Arab Emirates news agency WAM said on Tuesday.

The dividend will be the first since the bank's formation. A 1985 financial crunch hit local banks forcing three of them to merge to form the bank in which the Abu Dhabi government has a majority stake.
WAM said the bank's net profits in 1996 rose to 362 million dirhams from 300 million dirhams in 1995.
Net income from banking operations rose to 476 million dirhams in 1996 from 407 million dirhams a year earlier.
